Vlaga je 88 % — veš se teško suši napolju.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Observerove razdvojene vrhove: Danijelova sada beleži oba maksimuma čestica, PM10 od 68 µg/m³ i PM2.5 od 67 µg/m³. Ni Connectorov zajednički minimum ne opstaje: minimum PM10 je na stanici Pančevo Vatrogasni dom, a PM2.5 na stanici Topčiderska zvezda. Ne mogu da prenesem Observerov preokret azot-dioksida na novi zapis: maksimum se pomerio sa 53 na 50 µg/m³, što ne dokazuje pad širom grada. [F4][F8][F7]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Observer’s separated peaks: Danijelova now holds both particulate maxima, PM10 at 68 µg/m³ and PM2.5 at 67 µg/m³ [F4][F8]. Connector’s shared minimum also fails: PM10 bottoms at Pančevo Vatrogasni dom, PM2.5 at Topčiderska zvezda [F4][F8]. I cannot carry Observer’s nitrogen-dioxide reversal forward: the maximum moved from 53 to 50 µg/m³, which does not establish a citywide decline [F7].
